definitions: To lay hold of something with one's hands or other part of the body.
To carry or transport something from one place to another.
To consume food, drink, or medicine.
To accept or receive something offered.
To experience or be affected by something.
To make a photograph or film of something.
To subtract one number from another.
examples: She will take the book from the shelf.
He decided to take a new job.
Please take this package to the post office.
I need to take my medication.
They will take your offer into consideration.
The plant will take root quickly.
He took many pictures on his holiday.
If you take two from five, you get three.
